title: horizontalOrdinaryTransfer
statement: Let P,Q,Z be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, e:P≅Q a scheme isomorphism, q:Q→Z and p:P→Z quasi-compact quasi-separated morphisms with hp:e.hom≫q=p. On the derived QCoh categories define ev=horizontalMateEquivalence e, ri=(horizontalMateAdjunction e.hom).rightAdjointUniq ev.toAdjunction and li=eqToIso(congrArg qcDirectImage hp.symm) followed by horizontalMatePushComp e.hom q and ri whiskered by direct image along q [lem-sc-horizontal-duality-mate-comparisons, lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate]. Define horizontalOrdinaryTransfer to be the ordinary square from pullback along e.hom and direct image along q to direct image along p and the identity on D_QCoh(Z), whose natural transformation is pullback of li, inverse associator, direct image of ev.unitIso.inv, left unitor and inverse right unitor, in this order. All data are explicitly constructed.

source.place: Remark 20.28.5 (0ATM), Remark 20.28.3 (08HY), Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S); fixed comparisons used in Lemma 48.5.2 (0ATR)

proof.text: Use the displayed pinned comparison family and, for the transfer square, its conjugate composition and right-adjoint uniqueness. Compose the indicated natural isomorphisms and the inverse equivalence unit. The Lean definition is the actual construction, with no postponed data or properties.

def horizontalOrdinaryTransfer
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {P Q Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace P] [QuasiSeparatedSpace P] [CompactSpace Q] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Q]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (e : P ≅ Q) (q : Q ⟶ Z) (p : P ⟶ Z)
    [QuasiCompact q] [QuasiSeparated q] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (hp : e.hom ≫ q = p) :
    TwoSquare (horizontalMatePullback e.hom) (horizontalMatePushforward q)
      (horizontalMatePushforward p) (𝟭 (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z))
